summary: Valproic acid/divalproex/sodium valproate should remain a consolidated active-moiety row. The three existing PubMed RCT links are appropriate, McGuire1988 and the cannabidiol interaction trial should not be added, and the RR50 value of 19 percentage points is verified. Required updates are source-policy cleanup for the boxed-warning/evidence fields, correction of vomiting from 23% to 27% in the adverse-event list, and minor alias/trade-name additions for FDA-listed Depakote CP/Sprinkle Capsules.
